column1: # The vLLM perf branches the image is built from, in merge order.
# branch<TAB>fork head<TAB>upstream PR (- = none yet)[<TAB>parent branch].
# A branch with a parent is a fix stacked on that branch and applies as its
# diff from the parent's head. scripts/vllm-stack.sh checks each line against
# the fork and upstream; see docs/vllm-stack.md.
